_meta.description: Top-down outlines, height bands and belt/pipe ports of the buildables the map draws, in metres in each class's own actor frame (+x forward, +y right, the save's axes at yaw 0). docs/building-shapes.md.
_meta.licence: First-party measurements of the game's own assets, read from the reader's installed copy by tools/gen_building_shapes.py: simplified outlines and connector positions, not meshes.

source.method: LOD 0 of every mesh component, placed by the construction-script tree, rasterised at 10 cm, closed over 40 cm, hole-filled, traced and simplified to at most 48 vertices per ring; bands cut the same way from the highest point over each cell, opened over 30 cm first
